description:
Create a complete multi-day dive safari trip record for a liveaboard in Komodo National Park, Indonesia. The trip should be named 'Komodo Safari 2023' with location 'Labuan Bajo, Indonesia'. Add three dives to this trip:

Dive 1 - Crystal Rock: Date March 5, 2023, start time 09:00, duration 52 minutes, max depth 28 meters, gas Nitrox 32% O2 in a 12L cylinder at 232 bar, buddy 'Wayan Surya', tags 'current' and 'drift', notes 'Strong current from the north. Incredible school of barracuda at 15m. Drifted along the pinnacle wall.'

Dive 2 - Castle Rock: Date March 5, 2023, start time 14:00, duration 48 minutes, max depth 25 meters, gas Air (21% O2) in a 12L cylinder at 232 bar, buddy 'Wayan Surya', tags 'current', notes 'Mantas spotted at cleaning station on the north side.'

Dive 3 - Batu Bolong: Date March 6, 2023, start time 08:30, duration 45 minutes, max depth 32 meters, gas Nitrox 32% O2 in a 12L cylinder at 232 bar, buddy 'Adi Pratama', tags 'deep' and 'wall', notes 'Pristine wall dive with soft corals. Napoleon wrasse at safety stop.'

Save all dives and the trip.
